how_to_apply: Visit the official website www.sukma.gov.in to download the notification and prescribed application format.
Fill out the application form clearly in Hindi (Devanagari) or English capital letters.
Affix a self-attested latest passport-size photograph on the application form.

Enclose a separate empty envelope with self-address and postal stamp affixed.

content_sections.heading: Zila Panchayat Sukma Vacancy Details (Post-wise)
content_sections.text: There are a total of 8 vacancies available under this recruitment notification.

content_sections.heading: Zila Panchayat Sukma Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Candidates must be native residents of Chhattisgarh.

rows.qualification_required: First division B.E./Computer Science/M.C.A./M.Sc. (Computer Science)/B.E. (I.T.) / Dot Net Technology/Java/M.S.S.Q.L./Oracle knowledge given priority.
First division M.B.A./B.E./MRTM (Master of Rural Technology and Management)/Mathematics/Physics postgraduate.

Graduation in M.Sc. (Computer Science/Information Technology)/M.C.A. or equivalent from a recognized university OR Graduation in Computer Science/Information Technology with B.E./B.Tech or equivalent from a recognized university.
Higher Secondary with 50% marks in B.Com (55% for SC/ST, 50% for B.Com passed in second division for Bastar and Surguja divisions).

content_sections.heading: Zila Panchayat Sukma Age Limit
content_sections.text: Minimum age limit is 21 years and maximum age limit is 35 years for general administration department rules. Maximum age limit shall not exceed 45 years under any circumstances. Age is calculated as on 01.01.2026. Relaxation is applicable for Chhattisgarh residents and various categories as per instructions issued by the government from time to time.

content_sections.heading: Zila Panchayat Sukma Selection Process
content_sections.text: The selection process comprises merit list preparation based on educational qualifications, followed by a practical or skill test where candidates are called in a 1:10 ratio based on merit.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Zila Panchayat Sukma Recruitment
content_sections.text: Visit the official website www.sukma.gov.in to download the notification and prescribed application format. Fill out the application form clearly in Hindi (Devanagari) or English capital letters. Affix a self-attested latest passport-size photograph on the application form. Attach self-attested copies of all essential educational mark sheets, degree certificates, category certificates, domicile certificate, and work experience proofs. Enclose a separate empty envelope with self-address and postal stamp affixed. Write the name of the post applied for and category on top of the main envelope. Send the application via Registered Post or Speed Post to the Office of the Chief Executive Officer, Zila Panchayat Sukma, Pin Code 494111 on or before 30 October 2026 up to 05:30 PM.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Self-attested copies of mark sheets and certificates of educational qualifications Domicile certificate of Chhattisgarh Caste certificate issued by a competent authority Valid experience certificates with order numbers and employer details Disability certificate issued by a medical board (if applicable) Ex-serviceman certificate (if applicable) Passport size photograph

content_sections.heading: Zila Panchayat Sukma Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Applications received after the last date and time or through unauthorized modes will be rejected. A separate application must be submitted for each post. Incomplete, unclear or defective applications will be summarily rejected. Contract appointment will be initially for 1 year, extendable based on performance and annual evaluation. Candidates working in government or semi-government institutions must submit their application through proper channel with a No Objection Certificate (NOC). No TA/DA will be paid for attending the selection process.

faq.question: Q1. What is Zila Panchayat Sukma Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Zila Panchayat Sukma has invited offline applications to fill 8 contract vacancies for Computer Programmer, Programmer Officer, Assistant Programmer, and Accountant posts.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in Zila Panchayat Sukma Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 8 vacancies are advertised across various posts under the Vikas Bharat Rojgar aur Aajivika ke Liye Guarantee Mission.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for Zila Panchayat Sukma Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit offline applications by Registered or Speed Post is 30 October 2026 up to 05:30 PM.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required for Computer Programmer?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold a first division B.E./Computer Science/M.C.A./M.Sc. (Computer Science)/B.E. (I.T.) with priority given to knowledge of Dot Net Technology, Java, M.S.S.Q.L., and Oracle.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for Zila Panchayat Sukma Recruitment?
faq.answer: The minimum age is 21 years and the maximum age is 35 years as of 01.01.2026, with an upper limit cap of 45 years and applicable relaxations.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification does not mention any application fee.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply for Zila Panchayat Sukma vacancies?
faq.answer: Candidates must download the application form from the official website, fill it out, attach self-attested documents, and send it via Speed or Registered Post to the Office of the Chief Executive Officer, District Panchayat Sukma.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: Candidates are shortlisted into a merit list based on educational qualifications and then called for a practical or skill test.

faq.question: Q9. What is the salary for the Accountant post?
faq.answer: The consolidated pay for the Accountant post is Rs. 23,350/- per month under Pay Band 5200-20200 Level 06.

faq.question: Q10. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No, these are contract appointments made for a period of 1 year, subject to renewal based on performance and project requirements.
